notes.title: Who's Lila? OST and Palette Editor out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Who's Lila? OST is out![/h1]

Check it out here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929370/Whos_Lila_Soundtrack/?beta=0
50+ tracks and small in-game easter eggs for owners!

[h1]Who's Lila? Palette Editor[/h1]
The game now includes a palette editor and [b]Workshop[/b] support:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1697700/workshop/


In the main menu in the palette section you will now be able to create and share your own palettes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40949357/4d7c0622e5475561155a8d284ccdc9f2ea332826.jpg[/img]

(Keep in mind: the editor unlocks after finding at least 6 palettes in-game)

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE, Indiecup and other news
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DZ3fVK3zqWk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Who's Lila? is coming out February 23.[/h1]

Hey everyone! Sorry for the delay,
Who's Lila is ready content-wise, the debug phase is also near its end.

[h2]The game will feature:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 15 endings
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Unlockable palettes
[*] 50 + music tracks
[*] [i]arg elements[/i]
[*] and more!
[/list]

The Demo Saves are not going to be compatible with the final game, unfortunately.

[h1]Who's Lila? will be entering IndieCup, Winter Season 2022![/h1]
[b]IndieCup[/b] is the largest indie games competition in Eastern Europe - if you are an Eastern-European dev, I recommend you check it out! The application period closes in mid-February, so you still have time.

Link: [url=https://indiecup.net]https://indiecup.net[/url]

[h3]Next up:[/h3]
10. Feb - Trailer release + new Itch.io page

Stay tuned!
